test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The sum of the radius of the base and the height of a solid right circular cylinder is 39 cm. Its total surface area is 1716 cm². What is the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 2πr(r + h) = 1716 cm² and (r + h) = 39 cm.

Substitute (r + h): 2 × (22/7) × r × 39 = 1716 ⇒ r = (1716 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 39) = 7 cm.

Height h = 39 − 7 = 32 cm.

**Volume** = πr²h = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 32 = 154 × 32 = 4928 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 4928 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of radius (r) and height (h) = 39 cm; TSA = 1716 cm².

**Formula:** TSA of cylinder = 2πr(r + h); Volume = πr²h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d05d82d3b2c4db519603398f28846e3139945a08d416b3c7f9f9bcef7a71a780.png] 

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r × 39 = 1716

⇒ (44/7) × r × 39 = 1716

⇒ r = (1716 × 7) ÷ (44 × 39)

⇒ r = 7 cm

⇒ h = 39 − 7 = 32 cm

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 32

⇒ Volume = 22 × 7 × 32 = 154 × 32 = 4928

**∴ The correct answer is 4928 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the side surface of a cylinder is given by 2πrh.

Volume of a Hollow Cylinder

Volume = π(R² − r²)h, where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.

Divisibility Trick

Since the formula for volume contains π (22/7), the answer is usually a multiple of 11. 4928: (4+2) − (9+8) = 6 − 17 = −11 (divisible by 11).</p
